title: Palm Paradise | KEY.co
description_expanded: Experience unparalleled luxury in this newly constructed, eight-bedroom oceanview masterpiece on the Isle of Palms, just minutes from historic Charleston. Designed with refined coastal elegance, this home offers a serene retreat just steps from the beach. A spacious ground-floor garage and convenient elevator make arrivals effortless, leading you into an expansive, sunlit floor plan where the ocean breeze flows freely through floor-to-ceiling steel doors. The living area, dining space, and chef’s kitchen are crafted for seamless entertainment, featuring top-of-the-line appliances like a double stove, eight-burner gas range, commercial refrigerator, and dual dishwashers. The butler’s kitchenette, just off the pool deck, ensures poolside refreshments are always at hand. Each of the eight bedrooms is a private suite, complete with luxurious baths and streaming TVs, ensuring comfort and privacy for every guest. The first-floor king suites, two with rainfall showers and one with a tub, offer a haven of relaxation. On the second floor, you'll find four more exquisite suites, including a room with two queen beds and a sun porch with stunning Atlantic views. The third floor is a kid’s dream, with an entertainment room, built-in twin beds, and a private sun deck overlooking the ocean. This home isn't just a place to stay—it's a luxurious escape designed for creating unforgettable memories.

Features: Six spaces are available for parking.
Air conditioning: Not available at all properties
Not liable for hot tub injuries or illness
